product.ta-1600-30.summary: The TA 1600/30 separated the central cabinet from the display and keyboard workstations.
product.ta-1600-30.history: Triumph-Adler positioned it in the TA 1600 office range for installations with several workstations. The manual describes operation from a local or remote workstation.
product.ta-1600-30.technical.configurati: TAXO let operators work from the system’s workstations. The hardware manual describes loading it and distinguishes SMD and CMD disk units by configuration.
product.ta-1600-30.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-1600-30.technical.limitations: Model-specific firmware and startup verification remain pending.
